notes.title: Ghost Pirates has been fixed to work for everyone!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! 

This is Jason from Encore Software / Viva Media. I wanted to thank you all for being loyal fans of ours. I realize that our Ghost Pirates got off to a bad start for some users as the game would not launch. We had dilligently tried to reproduce the error on our machines at first, but were not able to do so.

Just a few weeks ago we revisited the issue and found that "Panda 3D" developed the libraries used in this game. So we reached out to R.D de Blois at Panda 3D for their guidance and the result? An updated game! Those of you who have the game installed will see a small update pushed out. This is updating the library.zip file that is within the game directory.

There are certain circumstances where the patch won't work immediately. If you have tried any work arounds on the forums or have messed with the Ghost Pirates Folder located in the Documents Folder, you will need to Delete All Local Content from your computer. Check the Steam Apps folder to make sure the Ghost Pirates folder does not exist. Also, delete the Ghost Pirates folder from the Documents folder.

Reboot your computer. Redownload the game and you should be good to go! We would like to thank R.D de Blois of Panda 3D for their excellent advice and hard work in getting this fix out to our customers. 

And a special thanks to our loyal fans! You're the best too! Again we're sorry for the initial troubles of this game but now everyone can enjoy this on their computer.
